entries.name: Resonance
entries.description: A hereditary magical phenomenon. Abel manifested his Resonance trait at seven winters old and possesses an unusual natural ability to project magic without an artificial focus.

entries.name: Frost Magic
entries.description: Abel's manifested magical expression. His control is currently poor; frost can leak through his armor when his control fails.

entries.name: Flux
entries.description: A powerful energy used throughout Aethelgard, including industrial and alchemical systems. Its exploitation has caused environmental damage.

entries.name: Ley-Tech
entries.description: Technology designed to conduct, redirect, measure, or manipulate magical currents.

entries.name: Ley-Shield
entries.description: Kael-Vossen's enormous protective barrier, appearing as a moving iridescent sapphire dome.

entries.name: Iron-Vein Filtration Networks
entries.description: Filtration infrastructure connected to the extraction and management of magical resources.

entries.name: Monolith Stabilization Arrays
entries.description: Large-scale arrays associated with stabilizing the region and preserving the protected basin. Their foundational coordinates are contained in the stolen archival material.

entries.name: Root-Pulse
entries.description: Clean energy moving through the living roots and infrastructure of Kael-Vossen.

entries.name: Reality Fissure
entries.description: A violent violet rupture across the sky that is widening and allowing hostile entities to enter the world.

entries.name: Spine-Whip
entries.description: A feared weapon associated with the Skull-Veil Inquisitors.

entries.name: Bone-Alchemy
entries.description: An elven discipline that has been distorted by imperial propaganda into monstrous stories about the Skull-Veil.
